title: Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi 2026 Review: Thailand's Coastal Gem 21K
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi 2026 Review | Thailand Race
meta_description: The Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi 2026: June 7 at Kung Wiman Beach. 21.1K, 10K, 5K, and 3K from Scenic Marathon Series at Thailand's eastern-seaboard coastal gem.
dek: Held 7 June 2026 at Kung Wiman Beach in Chanthaburi — Thailand's fruit-basket province — this Scenic Marathon Series event offered four distances from 3K up to a 21.1K half marathon.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi brought the Scenic Marathon Series to one of Thailand's most underrated coastal destinations — Kung Wiman Beach in Chanthaburi, a province known for its gemstone market, its fruit orchards, and a coastline that rivals Krabi without the crowds. A four-distance lineup (21.1K, 10K, 5K, and 3K) gave it broad appeal beyond just half-marathoners. June sits in the early wet season on Thailand's eastern seaboard. Registration was never formally opened before race day. For runners tracking the Scenic Series' coastal editions, this one is worth watching for a repeat.

sections.heading: Chanthaburi: Thailand's Hidden Coast
paragraphs: Chanthaburi is one of Thailand's most underrated provinces — known for its gemstone market, fruit orchards, and a coastline that's largely undiscovered by international tourism. [1] Kung Wiman Beach provides a scenic, uncrowded coastal road for the half marathon. Scenic Marathon Series handles production.
